definitions.explanation: The state of being unhappy or unfortunate.
A polite way to refer to a death in someone's family.

examples.japanese: {不幸|ふこう}な{子供|こども}{時代|じだい}を{過|す}ごした。
{彼|かれ}には{不幸|ふこう}が{続|つづ}いた。
{家族|かぞく}に{不幸|ふこう}があり、{欠席|けっせき}します。
examples.english: I will be absent due to a death in the family.
examples.notes: Euphemism for death in the family

notes:
USAGE: {不幸|ふこう} can describe general unhappiness, bad luck, or serve as a polite euphemism for death in the family.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{不幸|ふこう}な{出来事|できごと} (unfortunate event)
・{不幸|ふこう}に{見舞|みま}われる (to be struck by misfortune)
・{不幸|ふこう}にも (unfortunately)
・{不幸|ふこう}中|ちゅう}の{幸|さいわ}い (a silver lining)

ANTONYM: {幸福|こうふく} (happiness)
